newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-BRONDBY SELLS MOELLER TO PSV EINDHOVEN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRONDBY SELLS MOELLER TO PSV EINDHOVEN.

text.p: Danish superleague team Brondby said on Monday it had sold striker Peter Moeller to PSV Eindhoven for 11.65 million crowns ($1.7 million).
Moeller is currently the top scorer in this season's Danish superleague, having scored five goals for Brondby in only three matches played so far.
"After serious and difficult consideration, Brondby has decided to accept that Peter Moeller as per today is sold and transferred to PSV Eindhoven, Netherlands," Brondby said in a statement.
